name: Poligon "Sovyonok"
source:
This is a dark, sci-fi interpretation of the Everlasting Summer universe.

"Her world is the four walls of a room, where dusty curtains flutter in the draft. She is used to the pain, the IV drips, the pity in the doctors' eyes. Used to the fact that every day could be her last. But today, everything is different.

After yet another attack, she is offered salvation—an experimental treatment, a chance she never dared to dream of. No one tells her the price. No one warns her what 'complete body regeneration' actually means. And when she wakes up, she will no longer be the same. What will be left of her when the pain recedes? And who will she see in the mirror?"

The first chapter will immerse you in Yulya's past, showing the key moments that made her the person we are used to seeing.

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3522613749]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是对永夏宇宙的黑暗科幻诠释。

“她的世界就是房间的四堵墙，布满灰尘的窗帘在风中飘动。她习惯了疼痛、静脉滴注、医生眼中的怜悯。习惯了每天都可能是她的最后一天。但今天，一切都不同了。

在又一次袭击之后，她得到了拯救——一种实验性的治疗，一个她从来不敢梦想的机会。没有人告诉她价格。没有人警告她“身体完全再生”到底意味着什么。而当她醒来时，她将不再是原来的她了。当痛苦消退后，她还会剩下什么？她会在镜子里看到谁？”

第一章将让你沉浸在尤莉亚的过去中，展示使她成为我们所熟悉的人的关键时刻。

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3522613749]Steam[/url]]
